project.title: MassGIS · MassEnviroScreen
project.summary: A dedicated public project with thirty independently styled screening maps and one combined analysis over one shared, versioned MassGIS dataset.

collection.title: MassEnviroScreen
collection.summary: Thirty Massachusetts census block-group screening indicators and a combined cumulative-burden analysis, configured as maps that share one public MassGIS feature layer.
collection.attribution: MassGIS (Bureau of Geographic Information), Commonwealth of Massachusetts EOTSS
limitations: MassEnviroScreen is a screening tool and a starting point for further analysis; project decisions require project-specific analysis.
Indicators describe census block groups and statewide relative percentiles, not conditions at an individual address.
Exposure and climate-risk indicators do not measure personal or real-time exposure or risk.

The May 8, 2026 technical documentation reports 5,116 block groups while the reviewed live service query returned 5,109; clients must discover the current count and must not treat either number as a permanent invariant.
The ArcGIS item-specific description, copyright, and license fields are blank. Public-domain rights and the required source credit come from the linked official MassGIS pages.
